description.zh: tr 翻译、dict AI 词典：用本机的本地模型离线翻译，或用自己密钥的 DeepL、微软翻译及 OpenAI 兼容模型服务
description.en: tr translation and dict AI dictionary: offline with a local model on this computer, or with your own DeepL, Microsoft Translator or OpenAI-compatible service key

notes.zh: 每种翻译服务只用卡片上为它列出的几项：接口地址只给“OpenAI 兼容”用（预设的几家和微软用官方地址），模型只给大模型服务，区域只给微软；本地模型不发密钥。以前所有服务共用一个接口地址，留着别家的地址时选“本地模型”，请求会发到那里、报 401，现在本地模型总是连本机 127.0.0.1:39281。Win顺 0.53.0 起卡片只显示所选服务要填的几项，旧版本照旧全部显示。权限不变。
notes.en: Each service reads only the fields its card lists: the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible's alone (the presets and Microsoft use their official addresses), the model is for the chat services, the region for Microsoft; the local model sends no key. All services used to share one endpoint field, and an address left there from another service sent the local model's requests there (401); the local model now always uses 127.0.0.1:39281. From WinShun 0.53.0 the card shows only what the chosen service needs; older versions show every field as before. Permissions unchanged.
